SECTION 1: SPEC BULLET ANALYSIS

✅ * Select electrons with pT > 25 GeV and |eta| < 2.5; computed as: [e for e in get_electrons(event) if e['pt'] > 25 and abs(e['eta']) < 2.5]; upstream chain: get_electrons(event); 〔L295-L297〕
✅ * Select muons with pT > 25 GeV and |eta| < 2.4; computed as: [m for m in get_muons(event) if m['pt'] > 25 and abs(m['eta']) < 2.4]; upstream chain: get_muons(event); 〔L296-L297〕
✅ * Require exactly one lepton (electron or muon); computed as: if len(leptons) != 1: continue; upstream chain: leptons = electrons + muons; 〔L299-L300〕
✅ * Require at least 4 jets with pT > 30 GeV and |eta| < 2.5; computed as: [j for j in get_jets(event) if j['pt'] > 30 and abs(j['eta']) < 2.5]; upstream chain: get_jets(event); 〔L306-L307〕
✅ * Require at least 2 b-tagged jets; computed as: [b for b in get_bjets(event) if b['pt'] > 30 and abs(b['eta']) < 2.5]; upstream chain: get_bjets(event); 〔L312-L313〕
✅ * Select MET > 20 GeV; computed as: if met is None or met['pt'] < 20: continue; upstream chain: helper_get_met(event); 〔L318-L320〕
✅ * Select transverse mass of the lepton and MET between 30 and 150 GeV (W candidate); computed as: if not (30 < mt < 150): continue; upstream chain: helper_transverse_mass(lepton, met); 〔L324-L326〕
✅ * Build the hadronic W candidate from the two leading non-b-tagged jets; computed as: sum_objects(light_jets_sorted[0], light_jets_sorted[1]); upstream chain: light_jets_sorted = sort_by_pt(light_jets); 〔L336-L337〕
✅ * Select the hadronic W mass between 40 to 120GeV; computed as: if not (40 < w_hadronic['mass'] < 120): continue; upstream chain: helper_invariant_mass(light_jets_sorted[0], light_jets_sorted[1]); 〔L337-L339〕
✅ * Build the hadronic top candidate from the leading b-jet and the hadronic W candidate; computed as: sum_objects(bjets_sorted[0], w_hadronic); upstream chain: bjets_sorted = sort_by_pt(bjets); 〔L346-L347〕

✅ * Plot the transverse mass of lepton + MET (W leptonic candidate); computed as: mt_values; upstream chain: helper_transverse_mass(lepton, met); 〔L324-L328〕
✅ * Plot the MET distribution; computed as: met_values; upstream chain: met['pt']; 〔L318-L321, L329-L330〕
✅ * Plot the pT of the leading b-jet; computed as: leading_bjet_pt; upstream chain: bjets_sorted[0]['pt']; 〔L353-L354〕
✅ * Plot the pT of the subleading b-jet; computed as: subleading_bjet_pt; upstream chain: bjets_sorted[1]['pt']; 〔L356-L358〕
✅ * Plot the invariant mass of the two leading non-b-tagged jets (W hadronic candidate) in range 40 to 120 GeV; computed as: w_hadronic_mass; upstream chain: helper_invariant_mass(light_jets_sorted[0], light_jets_sorted[1]); 〔L336-L339, L340-L341〕
✅ * Plot the invariant mass of leading b-jet + W hadronic candidate (top hadronic) in range 100 to 250 GeV; computed as: top_hadronic_mass; upstream chain: helper_invariant_mass(bjets_sorted[0], w_hadronic); 〔L346-L347, L349-L350〕
✅ * Plot delta R between the leading lepton and the closest b-jet; computed as: delta_r_lepton_bjet; upstream chain: helper_delta_r(lepton, leading_bjet); 〔L360-L361〕
✅ * Plot the HT distribution (scalar sum of all jet pT); computed as: ht_values; upstream chain: scalar_pt_sum(jets); 〔L362-L363〕
✅ * Plot the number of jets per event; computed as: njets_values; upstream chain: len(jets); 〔L363-L364〕
✅ * Plot eta of the leading b-jet; computed as: leading_bjet_eta; upstream chain: leading_bjet['eta']; 〔L354-L355〕

✅ * After the event loop, print one cutflow summary with the number of events after each selection step; computed as: print statements for cutflow; upstream chain: cutflow dictionary; 〔L366-L445〕
✅ * Save the plots in png format; computed as: plt.savefig("filename.png"); upstream chain: plt.figure(), plt.hist(), plt.xlabel(), plt.ylabel(); 〔L366-L434〕

SECTION 2: DEFINITION SUMMARY

* [CHECK CAREFULLY] DEFINITION SUMMARY

* Selected electrons
  - computed/defined as: [e for e in get_electrons(event) if e['pt'] > 25 and abs(e['eta']) < 2.5]
  - upstream chain: get_electrons(event)
  - collection definition: e['pt'] > 25 and abs(e['eta']) < 2.5
  - structure: single-constituent

* Selected muons
  - computed/defined as: [m for m in get_muons(event) if m['pt'] > 25 and abs(m['eta']) < 2.4]
  - upstream chain: get_muons(event)
  - collection definition: m['pt'] > 25 and abs(m['eta']) < 2.4
  - structure: single-constituent

* Leptons (electrons + muons)
  - computed/defined as: electrons + muons
  - upstream chain: get_electrons(event), get_muons(event)
  - collection definition: electrons and muons with pT > 25 and |eta| < 2.5 or 2.4
  - structure: multi-input

* Selected jets
  - computed/defined as: [j for j in get_jets(event) if j['pt'] > 30 and abs(j['eta']) < 2.5]
  - upstream chain: get_jets(event)
  - collection definition: j['pt'] > 30 and abs(j['eta']) < 2.5
  - structure: single-constituent

* Selected b-jets
  - computed/defined as: [b for b in get_bjets(event) if b['pt'] > 30 and abs(b['eta']) < 2.5]
  - upstream chain: get_bjets(event)
  - collection definition: b['pt'] > 30 and abs(b['eta']) < 2.5
  - structure: single-constituent

* MET object
  - computed/defined as: helper_get_met(event)
  - upstream chain: for o in event['objects'] if o['type'] == 6
  - collection definition: MET object with type == 6
  - structure: single-constituent

* Transverse mass (lepton + MET)
  - computed/defined as: helper_transverse_mass(lepton, met)
  - upstream chain: helper_delta_phi(lepton['phi'], met['phi'])
  - collection definition: lepton and MET objects
  - structure: composite-derived

* Hadronic W candidate
  - computed/defined as: sum_objects(light_jets_sorted[0], light_jets_sorted[1])
  - upstream chain: helper_invariant_mass(light_jets_sorted[0], light_jets_sorted[1])
  - collection definition: two leading non-b-tagged jets
  - structure: composite-derived

* Hadronic top candidate
  - computed/defined as: sum_objects(bjets_sorted[0], w_hadronic)
  - upstream chain: helper_invariant_mass(bjets_sorted[0], w_hadronic)
  - collection definition: leading b-jet and hadronic W candidate
  - structure: composite-derived

* Leading b-jet
  - computed/defined as: bjets_sorted[0]
  - upstream chain: sort_by_pt(bjets)
  - collection definition: highest pT b-jet
  - structure: single-constituent

* Subleading b-jet
  - computed/defined as: bjets_sorted[1]
  - upstream chain: sort_by_pt(bjets)
  - collection definition: second highest pT b-jet
  - structure: single-constituent

* Delta R (lepton, b-jet)
  - computed/defined as: helper_delta_r(lepton, leading_bjet)
  - upstream chain: helper_delta_phi(lepton['phi'], leading_bjet['phi'])
  - collection definition: lepton and leading b-jet
  - structure: composite-derived

* HT (scalar sum of jet pT)
  - computed/defined as: scalar_pt_sum(jets)
  - upstream chain: sum(p['pt'] for p in jets)
  - collection definition: all selected jets
  - structure: composite-derived

* Number of jets
  - computed/defined as: len(jets)
  - upstream chain: [j for j in get_jets(event) if j['pt'] > 30 and abs(j['eta']) < 2.5]
  - collection definition: selected jets
  - structure: single-constituent
